source: People named by deceit.revealed_by who previously had no world record. Each has a settlement post and a quest-specific first line. | 2026-08-16 (F10 r13): 15 of these 16 posts carried invented world coordinates 5.1-9.7 km from the settlement each record names; four of them were the NPCs W1-F10-r11/r12's critics found DRAWN at (4906, -594) on ground -33 m, 6 km out to sea off Lilmoth, unowned for three verdicts. `captain-oreem` (archon, 22.3 m from centre) was the only correct one and is untouched.
